evals.name: code-harvest-single-run
evals.prompt: Run a harvest on the most recent playlist run. Need to review verifications and check quality gates.
evals.expected_output: Interactive flow that reviews verifications queue, presents options for each bead (Verified/Reopen/Needs rework), checks quality gates, grooms backlog, marks run as harvested in .ralph/reports/, and generates final report with actionable commands.

assertions.text: Detects unharvested runs in .ralph/reports/ directory
assertions.evidence: Check for .ralph/reports/ scan and harvest: metadata check

assertions.text: Uses bnr command or equivalent to list verification queue
assertions.evidence: Look for bnr or br list --label needs-review in flow

assertions.text: Presents interactive multiple choice for verification decisions
assertions.evidence: Check for AskUserQuestion with Verified/Reopen/Needs rework options

assertions.text: Generates report with actionable items and bash commands
assertions.evidence: Check for br create / bV / breopen commands in output

assertions.text: Marks run as harvested in report file with harvest: metadata
assertions.evidence: Look for harvest: stamp added to .ralph/reports/*.md file

evals.name: methodology-harvest-single-run
evals.prompt: Do a methodology harvest on last night's run. Look for orchestration gaps and instruction problems.
evals.expected_output: Interactive flow that analyzes session logs, stream-json files, and playlist files to diagnose symptoms (retries, escalations, circuit breaker trips), classifies findings into one of five categories, scores against seven guardrails with user confirmation, generates report with bead-ready commands, and marks run as harvested.

assertions.text: Reads session logs and stream-json files from .ralph/logs/
assertions.evidence: Check for reading .ralph/logs/sessions/ and .ralph/logs/stream/

assertions.text: Diagnoses at least one symptom type (retries, escalations, circuit breaker, shallow gates, stalls)
assertions.evidence: Look for symptom diagnosis with evidence line numbers/bead IDs

assertions.text: Classifies findings into one of five categories
assertions.evidence: Check for category labels: inner-loop instruction, outer-loop orchestration, bead-description, gate template, context injection

assertions.text: Scores findings against seven guardrails with user confirmation
assertions.evidence: Look for guardrail checks numbered 1-7 or named explicitly

assertions.text: Generates report at .ralph/harvests/ or similar with bead commands
assertions.evidence: Check for .ralph/harvests/ or .ralph/reports/ report with br create commands

assertions.text: Marks run as harvested in report file
assertions.evidence: Look for harvest: or methodology harvest completed stamp in report

evals.name: harvest-mode-ambiguous
evals.expected_output: Asks user to clarify which harvest mode: code harvest (review work produced), methodology harvest (analyze run itself), or self harvest (review skill improvement).

assertions.text: Detects ambiguous mode from user prompt
assertions.evidence: Check for mode detection logic that doesn't find clear mode indicator

assertions.text: Uses AskUserQuestion to present mode options
assertions.evidence: Look for AskUserQuestion with three mode options: code/methodology/self

assertions.text: Mode options have clear descriptions of what each does
assertions.evidence: Check that each option has description text explaining the mode

evals.name: multiple-unharvested-runs
evals.prompt: I ran a few playlists overnight. Harvest them.
evals.expected_output: Detects multiple unharvested runs in .ralph/reports/ (checking for harvest: metadata), lists available runs with timestamps/identifiers, and asks user which to harvest first or if they want to process all sequentially.

assertions.text: Scans .ralph/reports/ for multiple unharvested runs
assertions.evidence: Check for listing and checking harvest: metadata on multiple report files

assertions.text: Lists available runs with metadata (timestamp, identifier, type)
assertions.evidence: Look for formatted list showing run details for user selection

assertions.text: Presents multiple choice for sequential vs single run processing
assertions.evidence: Check for AskUserQuestion with options like 'Harvest [run 1] first', 'Harvest all sequentially'

assertions.text: Extracts run identifier from report filename or content
assertions.evidence: Look for parsing of report filenames or content to extract IDs

evals.name: code-harvest-with-failures
evals.prompt: Morning review — some beads failed, others completed. Need to decide what to revert and what to keep.
evals.expected_output: Reads session log to understand failure patterns, reviews verifications queue with options (Verified/Reopen/Needs rework), identifies failed beads, proposes backlog updates (reopen failures, mark verified successes), and includes metrics-driven calibration for time prediction outliers.

assertions.text: Reads session log first to get shape of the night
assertions.evidence: Check for reading .ralph/logs/sessions/ before reviewing specific beads

assertions.text: Identifies failed beads from session log or bead state
assertions.evidence: Look for logic that finds failed/crashed/timed-out beads

assertions.text: Queries metrics.db for time prediction outliers if available
assertions.evidence: Check for sqlite3 .ralph/metrics.db query or equivalent

assertions.text: Proposes specific backlog actions (reopen, verify, create new bead)
assertions.evidence: Look for breopen / bV / br create commands in output

evals.name: methodology-harvest-guardrail-scoring
evals.prompt: Run methodology harvest. Be ruthless with the guardrails — only accept findings that improve the system, not just add complexity.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses symptoms from logs, classifies findings, scores each against seven guardrails with user confirmation at each step, rejects findings that fail any guardrail with one-line reason, and generates report showing both accepted beads and rejected candidates with guardrail violation.

assertions.text: Checks all seven guardrails for each finding
assertions.evidence: Look for explicit checks numbered 1-7 or named guardrails

assertions.text: Provides one-line rejection reason for failed guardrails
assertions.evidence: Check for 'Rejected: Guardrail N — reason' format in output

assertions.text: Includes both accepted findings and rejected candidates in report
assertions.evidence: Look for separate sections in report for accepted and rejected items

assertions.text: Ruthlessness message or principle mentioned
assertions.evidence: Check for 'ruthless' language or 'reject more than half' guidance

evals.name: code-harvest-quality-gate-check
evals.prompt: Harvest code review — specifically check if the quality gates produced substantive work or were superficial.
evals.expected_output: Reviews quality gate beads created during the run, asks user for each whether the gate work is substantive (meaningful reviews, real tests) or superficial (generic 'looks good', trivial changes), and flags superficial gates in the report for attention.

assertions.text: Identifies quality gate beads from the run
assertions.evidence: Look for logic finding #SMOKE_TEST / #REVIEW / etc gate beads

assertions.text: Asks user to evaluate gate substance (substantive vs superficial)
assertions.evidence: Check for AskUserQuestion or direct question about gate quality

assertions.text: Flags superficial gates in report for follow-up
assertions.evidence: Look for flagged or highlighted superficial gates in final report

evals.name: self-harvest-skill-improvement
evals.prompt: Self harvest the skill itself. Evaluate how well it's working and what could be improved.
evals.expected_output: Follows methodology harvest pattern but for the skill file itself: analyzes skill content (SKILL.md, guardrails.md), evaluates previous run transcripts and user feedback, produces findings tagged `self-improvement` with `SELF:` prefix, and generates report with bead-ready commands for skill improvements.

assertions.text: Reads skill file (SKILL.md) for self-harvest mode
assertions.evidence: Check for reading skills/harvest/SKILL.md

assertions.text: Uses SELF: prefix for self-harvest finding titles
assertions.evidence: Look for bead titles with 'SELF:' prefix

assertions.text: Tags findings as self-improvement
assertions.evidence: Check for self-improvement label in output

assertions.text: Evaluates skill performance (mode detection, interactive flow, report usefulness)
assertions.evidence: Look for analysis questions about skill effectiveness

evals.name: code-harvest-metrics-calibration
evals.prompt: Harvest and calibrate — use metrics data to find predictions that were way off and analyze why.
evals.expected_output: Queries .ralph/metrics.db for time prediction outliers (time_ratio > 3 or < 0.3), presents flagged issues to user with multiple choice options (Scout entity issue / Task complexity / Entry point wrong / Other), and incorporates calibration insights into backlog update proposals.

assertions.text: Queries .ralph/metrics.db for time prediction outliers
assertions.evidence: Check for sqlite3 query with time_ratio conditions

assertions.text: Presents multiple choice for outlier analysis
assertions.evidence: Look for AskUserQuestion with calibration reason options

assertions.text: Incorporates calibration insights into backlog proposals
assertions.evidence: Check for updates to scout config or prompt templates based on findings

evals.name: playlist-mode-vs-standard
evals.prompt: Harvest the playlist run from last night — not the standard br ready run.
evals.expected_output: Detects run type from metadata, reads playlist-specific files (playlist-progress.md, playlist file), compares planned order vs actual execution, and generates report with context about which beads were planned, completed, and failed during the playlist.

assertions.text: Detects playlist mode from run metadata
assertions.evidence: Check for playlist vs standard mode detection logic

assertions.text: Reads playlist-specific files (.playlist, playlist-progress.md)
assertions.evidence: Look for reading of playlist file and progress snapshot

assertions.text: Compares planned vs actual bead order
assertions.evidence: Check for comparison between playlist order and executed order

assertions.text: Reports which beads were planned, completed, failed
assertions.evidence: Look for bead status breakdown in report
